items.summary: Discussion questions on francophone media, magazines, and journals worldwide.
Matches francophone authors to writing/translation status; introduces Dossier 5 projects.
Reads a Japanese professor's project and two students' learning journals in French.
Grammar focus completing passe compose rules with avoir/etre, plus a listening interview task.
Reading article ranking five young Acadian talents in music, sports, and academics.
Grammar practice on passe recent, futur proche, and verb dire, with a listening task.
Listening exercise completing Ahmadou Kourouma's biography; reads Tahar Ben Jelloun's biography.
Reads Andrei Makine's biography, compares two writers' timelines, studies passe compose with etre.
Reading and listening about a TV book show; matches characters to physical descriptions.
Reads literary character descriptions; groups write physical-description portraits like the authors.
Reading article about chef Keisuke Matsushima's fusion restaurant and career in Nice.
True/false listening about two fusion chefs; corrects a learner's errors; writes a chef profile.
Reading a press-directory website (Giga Presse) and extracting its usage advice.
Listening to ten reporting commandments; classifies them and studies the imperative for advice.
Video listening about a themed bookshop, Le Barbouquin a Belleville, in Paris.
Reading and true/false about the France 24 TV channel's structure, schedule, and programs.
Matches biography elements to portray a francophone celebrity (Viggo Mortensen).
DELF exam: reading comprehension on Amin Maalouf's biography plus oral production tasks.
Discussion on a world map showing francophone speaker populations by region.
Francophone world map exercise; introduces Dossier 6 travel-planning class projects.
True/false reading about a Madagascar photography-tour travel agency website.
Future tense grammar practice plus listening to a Madagascar trip phone call.
Reading matches 'mission' versus 'immersion' trips; profiles Burkina Faso.
Multiple-choice on Burkina Faso; grammar on the pronoun y and locating places.
Listening to a sound-postcard contest; matches French cities to descriptions and colors.
Reading a flyer ranking top 5 French cities; adjective-placement grammar practice.
Reading a Moroccan guesthouse (Kasbah) website describing rooms and hospitality.
Grammar on -ir verbs; listening to guests reviewing their stay at the Kasbah.
Reading a travel-weather website comparing climate and seasons across countries.
Listening to an African weather forecast; grammar for describing climate and forecasts.
